description: This file defines interfaces, configuration structs, and callback mechanisms for asynchronous int64 measurement instruments in the OpenTelemetry metrics SDK, including counters, up-down counters, gauges, and observers.

methods.name: NewInt64ObservableCounterConfig
methods.description: Returns a new Int64ObservableCounterConfig with all options applied.

methods.name: Description
methods.description: Returns the configured description of the counter config.

methods.name: Unit
methods.description: Returns the configured unit of the counter config.

methods.name: Callbacks
methods.description: Returns the configured callbacks of the counter config.

methods.name: NewInt64ObservableUpDownCounterConfig
methods.description: Returns a new Int64ObservableUpDownCounterConfig with all options applied.

methods.name: Description
methods.description: Returns the configured description of the up-down counter config.

methods.name: Unit
methods.description: Returns the configured unit of the up-down counter config.

methods.name: Callbacks
methods.description: Returns the configured callbacks of the up-down counter config.

methods.name: NewInt64ObservableGaugeConfig
methods.description: Returns a new Int64ObservableGaugeConfig with all options applied.

methods.name: Description
methods.description: Returns the configured description of the gauge config.

methods.name: Unit
methods.description: Returns the configured unit of the gauge config.

methods.name: Callbacks
methods.description: Returns the configured callbacks of the gauge config.

methods.name: WithInt64Callback
methods.description: Adds a callback to be called for an instrument.
